title: Survey Vessel Stargazer
author: Scott
excerpt: Survey Vessel Stargazer is a crashed Diamondback Explorer in the HIP 16378 system on 3 b, at 37.1042, -148.0340 (in Live/4.0) or at 37.0649, -147.8056 (in Legacy/3.8). The location of this site can be found by reading the Station Herald at Maia, or by following the two listening posts located in:Bhadaba / HIP 16378 Herald…
